data.name: Chidanand
data.gender_notes: Chidanand is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chida (inner being or soul) + Anand (bliss). The name Chidanand carries the meaning “Pure Bliss” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chidanand usually hope their child will grow to embody pure bliss and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who seeks inner peace and happiness.
data.etymology: Chidanand belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure Bliss.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chidanand total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_sanskrit.name: चिदानन्द
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: चिद (chid) meaning consciousness, आनन्द (anand) meaning bliss

in_hindi.name: चिदानन्द
in_hindi.meaning: चिद (chid) का अनन्द (anand) hai | consciousness is bliss
in_hindi.long_meaning: चिद (chid) राशि (rashi) में ज्योतिषीयता (jyotishiyata) के साथ, हिंदू धर्म में चिदानन्द का नाम चित्त (chitt) के लिए प्रार्थना (prarthana) वाला पुरुष (purush) के लिए दिया गया है | Consciousness is the prayer of the soul.

in_tamil.name: சிதானந்த
in_tamil.meaning: சித் (chit) அனந்தம் (anandam) இல்லை | consciousness is bliss
in_tamil.long_meaning: சித் (chit) அக்கிரமம் (akkiramam) மேல் அனந்தம் (anandam) இல்லை | சித் (consciousness) இல்லை அனந்தம் (bliss) இல்லை, அவ்வளவு அடிக்கட்டம் இருக்கிறது | consciousness and bliss are inseparable.

in_telugu.name: చిదానన్ద
in_telugu.meaning: చిద్ (chid) ఆనంద్ (anandam) ఇల్లజేదోదే | consciousness is bliss
in_telugu.long_meaning: చిద్ (chid) ఆదేశ్య (adhishyam) ఆయిన ఆనంద్ (anandam) ఇల్లజేదోదే | చిద్ (consciousness) ఆయిన ఆదేశ్య (lord) ఆదే ఆనంద్ (bliss) ఇల్లజేదోదే | consciousness and bliss are inseparable.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Pure Bliss

data.cultural_impact: The name "Chidanand" signifies the inner pursuit of attaining eternal bliss. It is a name that has been cherished in Hindu culture for its deep meaning and association with the traditional quest for enlightenment and self-realization.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, "Chidanand" represents the ultimate goal of spiritual pursuit - the attainment of inner peace and bliss. It is a reminder of the importance of looking inward and focusing on the soul as the source of true happiness and fulfillment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chidanand means "Pure Consciousness," representing the innermost self, untouched by worldly impurities or delusions. It is a reminder of our true nature beyond the physical form.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Chidanand was a renowned Hindu scholar and philosopher during the medieval period. The name Chidanand carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
